description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - route hold: someone gives you directions in one breath (turn left, straight on, right at the second light) and reciting them while you walk is how you get lost. You repeat the route in your own voice (host speech recognition, after a wearer-mode mic availability check); dictate it step by step with each step confirmed, or dictate it whole and the agent splits it on step markers into a review list you prune before saving. Steps are held as text on the glasses and survive closing the agent. While you walk, only the current step is in front of your eyes; a steady nod or Enter means YOU judge that step done - the agent never advances on its own, it has no position and no map: there is deliberately no geolocation permission. Swipe up goes back a step, PEEK (off by default) peeks at the next step, and when the steps run out it says the route is finished - whether you have arrived is your judgement, never its claim.
name: route-hold
